title: Game menu
changes: Press Esc (or click ☰ Menu) to open the new game menu: Music & sound, Ideas board and News are now in one place.
New in the menu: Save and return to start screen, to go back to the fire and resume or start a new game.
The Ideas board, News and Music & sound panels now use the same weathered frames as the other menus.
I and N still open the Ideas board and News directly. Esc still closes any open window first.
